data.title: Goodwill Industries of Eastern North Carolina, Inc. (GIENC®) Launches Food Market in Eastern North Carolina Food Desert
data.description: The Goodwill Community Cupboard located in Aurora is now open, offering affordable access to nutritious food. This initiative was launched by Goodwill Industries of Eastern North Carolina (GIENC®) in Durham. The newly opened Goodwill Community Cupboard at 150 South 5th Street aims to provide healthy food options to the community at reasonable prices. This move by GIENC® signifies a commitment to addressing food accessibility issues in the area.

data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops Suitcase with Modified Wheels (LOS-656)
data.description: In Pittsburgh on September 15, 2026, an inventor from Bakersfield, California shared his inspiration for creating a new suitcase concept called WHEELS UP. The inventor wanted to address the issue of damaged wheels when not in use and aimed to provide a solution. The innovative design of WHEELS UP ensures that luggage wheels are protected from damage, eliminating the inconvenience of dealing with broken wheels.

data.title: Fatty Liver Disease Early Signs Detailed in HelloNation Article Featuring Health Expert Dr. Karen Jerome-Zapadka
data.description: The report delves into the reasons behind the silent nature of fatty liver disease and highlights the importance of screening in maintaining overall liver health. Recently, in CRANBERRY TOWNSHIP, Pennsylvania, on September 15, 2026, HelloNation released an article addressing this issue. The article discusses the prevalence of undetected fatty liver disease and emphasizes the significance of early detection for long-term liver wellbeing.

data.title: Palmetto Publishing Releases Farzaneh's New Memoir About One Woman's Journey from Iran to Freedom
data.description: Palmetto Publishing has recently released a new book titled "Ascent," detailing the journey of an Iranian woman who went from a childhood marked by silence and religious oppression to eventually discovering her voice in the United States. This book offers an inspiring narrative of self-discovery and resilience. The publication date was September 15, 2026, in Charleston, South Carolina.

data.title: "50X50: SCIENCE ACROSS AMERICA" GOES LIVE TODAY, UNITING THE BEST YOUTUBE CREATORS IN THE FIRST-EVER STATE-BY-STATE MEDIA INITIATIVE
data.description: On the launch day, a group of creators with a total YouTube following exceeding 90 million subscribers came together to showcase a homegrown creator and scientist from each state. New videos will be released on a weekly basis, rolling out by region until mid-November. The event took place in Austin, Texas on September 15, 2026.

data.title: The Black Church Will No Longer Accept Symbolism: National Faith Leaders Unite Behind "Substance Over Symbolism" Campaign Ahead of September 17 Rally
data.description: The Black Church Center for Justice & Equality has initiated the SOSforAmerica.org campaign, proclaiming basic economic rights as the remaining task of the Civil Rights Movement. The event, set for Sept. 15, 2026 in Clinton, Md., will witness the gathering of Black pastors and congregants in a rally. The organization aims to highlight the urgency of economic empowerment through this campaign, emphasizing the importance of addressing this issue.

data.title: Wheeler Resource Recovery Sets 2027 Production Goals for Madison Waterflood Field, President Kevin K. Thibeau outlines next phase of development for the company's flagship Texas asset
data.description: Today, in Fort Worth, Texas, the president of Wheeler Resource Recovery, Kevin K. Thibeau, revealed plans to enhance production, bolster project cash flow, and further tap into the untapped oil reserves of the Madison Waterflood Field before the end of the year. Thibeau has been leading the company since 2014, and is determined to achieve these objectives to advance the company's growth. This initiative aims to significantly increase output and financial stability for the company, as it continues to exploit the remaining oil resources in the field.

data.title: Protecting Approved Care: AAOS Endorses New Medicare Advantage Bill
data.description: On September 15, 2026, in Washington, the American Association of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS) announced their support for the Protecting Approved Care Act. This new legislation aims to tackle retroactive reimbursement adjustments, commonly referred to as clawbacks by insurers, within the Medicare system. The Act addresses the issue of unexpected payment changes and seeks to provide more stability for healthcare providers. The AAOS believes this legislation will play a crucial role in safeguarding the financial interests of healthcare professionals and ensuring a transparent reimbursement process.

data.title: ‘Bitcoin Senator’ Lummis Urges Immediate Action on Clarity Act, offering Democrats over 120 of their demands, ahead of pivotal Senate vote tomorrow.
data.description: The Wyoming Republican reported that the final text includes over 120 demands from Democrats, such as extensive new ethics regulations. The Senate will have a crucial cloture vote on Tuesday afternoon.

data.title: SANY Heavy Truck Debuts Production-Ready Electric Truck Portfolio at IAA Transportation 2026
data.description: SANY Heavy Truck, in partnership with Putzmeister, a subsidiary of SANY Group, showcased its presence at the IAA Transportation 2026 event held in HANNOVER, Germany on September 15, 2026. The event highlighted SE636, a key product in SANY's portfolio, with customers having the opportunity to participate in test drives. As part of its strategic approach towards the European market, SANY emphasized its long-term commitment by promoting an established service network designed to cater to the needs of customers in the region. This event not only marked the debut of SANY Heavy Truck at IAA Transportation 2026 but also served as a platform to demonstrate the company's dedication to Europe.

data.title: Faye Unveils New Integration Connecting Intercom and NetSuite, Giving Support Teams Instant Access to Financial Data
data.description: A recent integration now allows for seamless synchronization of contact, company, and financial data between two platforms, enabling customer-facing teams to access information without exiting Intercom. This development was announced in CALABASAS, Calif., on September 15, 2026. Faye, a prominent player in software strategy and AI deployment, spearheaded this initiative to enhance operational efficiency.

data.title: PRRS Responds to MPS Statements at the 2026 National Parking Association Conference & Expo
data.description: Las Vegas, on September 15, 2026 - The current announcement aims to provide clarification on MPS's recent declarations, particularly those communicated to Parking Revenue Recovery Services, Inc. ("PRRS") clients and attendees at the 2026 NPA Conference and Expo. Updates on the patent claims made in June will be discussed.

data.title: TMEIC Opens New Power Electronics Flagship Manufacturing Facility in Waller County, Texas
data.description: In Waller County, Texas, on September 15, 2026, TMEIC Corporation Americas unveiled its latest manufacturing plant, Twinwood, covering an area of 280,000 square feet. This facility marks the third in the United States for the company and is a subsidiary of TMEIC Corporation in Japan.

data.title: Rizing Tide Named Philanthropic Partner for Second Edition of "Called to Care"
data.description: Dr. Larry Benz has announced that he will be contributing all proceeds from his latest book to aid in funding scholarships for upcoming physical therapists from marginalized communities. This decision was revealed in Phoenix on September 15, 2026, and will benefit Rizing Tide, an organization focused on increasing opportunities in physical therapy. The initiative aims to support individuals who face obstacles due to underrepresentation in the field.
